title: origanum viride
intro: Origanum viride, commonly known as Green Oregano or Wild Marjoram, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the relief of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Origanum viride include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
